decisions.decision: Use git rev-parse --short HEAD instead of git log --oneline in devMike.bat
decisions.rationale: git log --oneline includes commit subject which may contain angle brackets that cmd.exe interprets as redirection operators, crashing the for /f loop

decisions.decision: Sort .planning dirs by primary-repo-first in discover loop
decisions.rationale: os.walk order is filesystem-dependent; worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ can sort before the repo root alphabetically, causing the real .planning/ to be silently skipped as a duplicate. Sorting by whether ../.git is a directory (real repo) vs file (worktree) guarantees the authoritative ROADMAP wins.
